items.summary: Yuuto Suzuki's Sakamoto Days manga has concluded with chapter 284 in the 52nd issue of Weekly Shounen Jump magazine on Monday, after 6-year serialization. Suzuki originally drew the action comedy manga as a one-shot in Jump GIGA magazine in December 2019. The manga began serializing in the Weekly Shounen Jump in November 2020. Shueisha published the 29th volume on November 4. The manga has over 18 million copies in circulation. Produced by TMS Entertainment, the first season aired in split.
